title: Sleep Well Live Well (SWELL) Pilot Project
brief_summary: This will be a 12 week randomized control trial of sleep hygiene education vs. no education with a cross-over to the active intervention after 6 weeks. Primary and secondary outcomes will be assessed before and after a 10-20 minute sleep hygiene video (intervention).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Reside in Harrison County of West Virginia
* Ability to read and understand English
* Ability to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to read and understand English
* Inability or unwillingness to provide informed consent
* Presence of sleep apnea
* Depression
* Severe insomnia
* Using prescription sleeping medication or narcotics
* Acute illness including stroke, heart attack, heart failure or pneumonia with or without COVID-19 infection requiring hospital admission within the last 8 weeks
